variables.name: MODE_UNIT
variables.description: Maximum mode on docker.service, docker.socket, daemon.json, /etc/default/docker, and /etc/sysconfig/docker. Each digit is a ceiling. Remediation sets the file to this mode.

variables.name: MODE_DOCKER_DIR
variables.description: Maximum mode on /etc/docker. Each digit is a ceiling. Remediation sets the directory to this mode.

variables.name: MODE_CERT
variables.description: Maximum mode on registry certificate files.

variables.name: MODE_KEY
variables.description: Maximum mode on registry private keys.

variables.name: MODE_SOCK
variables.description: Maximum mode on docker.sock and containerd.sock. Each digit is a ceiling. Remediation sets the socket to this mode.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Daemon log-level the check accepts. An unset level still passes. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: FORBIDDEN_STORAGE
variables.description: Storage driver that fails the check.

variables.name: FORBIDDEN_LOG_DRIVER
variables.description: Logging driver that fails the check. An empty driver also fails.

variables.name: PRIVILEGED_PORT
variables.description: Published host ports below this value fail the check.

variables.name: CGROUP_DRIVERS
variables.description: Comma-separated cgroup drivers the check accepts.
